The historical backtest found zero of 30 later edges in the top 200, including baseline; ranking quality is unvalidated.

Focus uses undirected semantic-edge radius, not a canonical Holon boundary; MindrianOS must authorize and scope input, supply source evidence, conduct review, and perform any graph write.
